title: Untwisted inverse-image section-cohomology comparisons
statement: Let f:X→T be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], q a natural number, and V≤W opens of T. Put Y=(f inverse W).toScheme, G=F restricted to Y, L=the tensor unit, K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-pc-section-cohomology-presheaf]. Give P(V) its Gamma(T,W)-action by restriction of scalars. For every open U of Y whose image under the inclusion into X is f inverse V, there are additive equivalences e:H^q(U,G)≃P(V) and t:H^q(Y,G)≃P(W) [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. They commute with restriction from the top open to U and from W to V. For every r in Gamma(T,W), let b be its global pullback on Y and let m_b:G→G be inverse right unitor followed by tensoring with the unit morphism determined by b followed by the right unitor. Then e(H^q(U,m_b)(z))=r e(z). There are no affine, quasi-coherent, compactness or positivity assumptions.

proof.text: Apply lem-pc-resolution-open-restriction-natural with V≤W and the given U and image equality. It supplies d:P(V)≃+H^q(U,G) and the square res_U(c(x))=d(P(res)(x)). Define e=d.symm and t=c.symm; rewriting the supplied square by these inverses gives e(res_U(c(x)))=P(res)(t(c(x))) and hence the required restriction commutation for every top class.

proof.text: For r∈Γ(T,W), instantiate lem-pc-resolution-open-scalar-core at n=1 to obtain the top-open scalar equation H^q(m_b)(c(x))=c(r•x). By functoriality in the coefficient morphism in def-sc-open-module-cohomology, restriction satisfies the explicit naturality square res_U(H^q(m_b)(ξ))=H^q(m_b)(res_U(ξ)). Substitute ξ=c(x), then use the restriction square from lem-pc-resolution-open-restriction-natural and the top scalar equation; applying e=d.symm yields e(H^q(U,m_b)(z))=r•e(z) for z, with no invertibility assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomology_untwisted_comparisons {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (q : ℕ) (W V : T.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W) :
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let L := 𝟙_ Y.Modules
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let : Module Γ(T, W) (P.obj (op V)) :=
      Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
    ∀ (U : Y.Opens), (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ''ᵁ U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V →
      ∃ e : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G ≃+
          P.obj (op V),
      ∃ t : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj G ≃+
          P.obj (op W),
      (∀ (r : Γ(T, W)) (z : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G),
        e ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).map
          ((ρ_ G).inv ≫ G ◁ homOfGlobalSection L
            (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ (((f.app W) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).topIso.inv).hom r)) ≫
              (ρ_ G).hom) z) = r • e z) ∧
      (∀ ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj G,
        e ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app G ξ) =
            (P.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (t ξ))
